review_candidates.title: Software Developer
review_candidates.description: Seal Dynamics (A HEICO Company) founded in 1976, with its corporate headquarters based in Hauppauge, NY is a world leader in technical sales and the distribution of aerospace components. Our unique marketing and technical sales approach are the most effective way to assist our customers in selecting products that reduce cost of ownership. Our current product portfolio includes structural, mechanical and electro-mechanical products associated with both airframe and engine applications across all ATA Chapters. Through our strategic partnerships with some of the most respected OEMs in the aviation industry, Seal Dynamics stocks and distributes in excess of 100,000 products globally in support of our customer requirements. In addition to our distribution network, Seal Dynamics is a market leader in the design and development of FAA approved alternative parts. Our OEM licensed PMAs and Test and Computation PMAs offer our customers viable solutions in the reduction of operational costs. Seal Dynamics is growing its IT development team, and we’re hiring an entry-level developer to grow with us. You’ll write SQL and C# against the systems that keep a global aviation parts business running. ERP, eCommerce, partner integrations, document management, and warehouse logistics and you’ll have a hand in the work we’re building out now: REST integrations between our systems and AI capabilities wired directly into our business data. This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to learn a real enterprise stack end to end. On-site in Hauppauge, Long Island. This is not a remote or hybrid position, and it is not a contract role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Seal Dynamics offers a 9/80 work schedule, upon completion of the introductory period, you can opt to enroll and have every other Friday off. , What You’ll Do Write, test, and tune T-SQL queries, views, stored procedures against our ERP and line-of-business databases Build and maintain C#/.NET applications and services Build and consume REST APIs - the integrations that connect our core business systems to each other and to outside partners. This is core to the job, not a side task. Work on our AI integration efforts - connecting LLM APIs and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to business data, so the business can ask real questions of real systems Write Python for data work, automation, and AI-adjacent tooling Support and enhance internal web applications Work in containerized development and deployment environments Work directly with people in purchasing, warehouse, sales, and finance to understand what they actually need before you build it Follow source control, code review, and change management practices and help us improve them Our stack You are not expected to know all of this. This is what you’ll be working with and learning here. The short “required” list below is what we will actually screen on everything else is something we’ll teach you. Area What We Use Data Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing and query tuning Backend C# / .NET, VB.NET, Python Integration REST / JSON APIs, webhooks, file-based and partner interfaces AI LLM APIs, MCP servers, AI-assisted development tooling BI & reporting Power BI, DAX, SQL Server Reporting Services Web HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React Tooling Docker, Git / GitHub, Visual Studio Business systems ERP, eCommerce, warehouse management, document management What We’re Looking For Required - this is the real list Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp, military, self-taught with a portfolio we can look at) Working knowledge of SQL: you can write a multi-table join, understand what an index does, and know why SELECT * in production code is a bad habit Familiarity with at least one object-oriented language - C# preferred, but Java, Python, or VB.NET experience transfers Basic understanding of how REST APIs work: requests, responses, JSON, status codes, authentication Basic familiarity with source control (Git/GitHub) Clear written and verbal communication - much of this job is asking a non-technical person the right question Curiosity and initiative: you research before you escalate, and you flag problems early rather than hoping they go away Coursework, internships, co-ops, and personal projects all count. If you’ve built something you’re proud of, tell us about it. Helpful, Not Required - We’ll Teach You These Python beyond the basics, especially for data or automation work Any hands-on work with LLM APIs, MCP, RAG, or embeddings - including personal projects Experience using AI coding assistants on real code, and the judgment to review what they produce Docker or other containerization Power BI, DAX, or other BI and reporting tools React or another modern front-end framework ERP development experience (Infor SyteLine / CloudSuite Industrial a plus) EDI or other B2B partner integration experience Exposure to distribution, manufacturing, inventory, or warehouse systems Aviation or other regulated-industry experience

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für Backend-Anwendungen, Architekturentscheidungen und Entwicklungsstandards und bist gleichzeitig weiterhin hands-on in der Entwicklung tätig. Wichtig: Hier geht es um Technical Leadership, nicht um disziplinarische oder personelle Führung. Du überzeugst mit technischem Know-how, klaren Entscheidungen und der Fähigkeit, andere Entwickler fachlich mitzunehmen. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Backend-Anwendungen mit C# und .NET (aktuell .NET 10) Du gestaltest die Softwarearchitektur , triffst nachhaltige technische Entscheidungen und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher Du definierst und etablierst technische Standards, Best Practices und Qualitätsrichtlinien rund um Clean Code, Performance, Security und Wartbarkeit Du entwickelst weiterhin hands-on und setzt komplexe Features gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam um Du begleitest die technologische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme mit Docker und Kubernetes Du konzipierst und optimierst Microservices-Architekturen und nutzt RabbitMQ und Apache Kafka für die asynchrone Kommunikation verteilter Services Du unterstützt andere Entwickler als technischer Sparringspartner , begleitest Code Reviews und förderst den fachlichen Wissensaustausch Du verantwortest die technische Umsetzung neuer Features von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zum produktiven Betrieb Du setzt KI-Tools wie Claude Code gezielt ein, um Entwicklungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten Gemeinsam mit Product, Fachbereichen und weiteren Stakeholdern übersetzt du komplexe Anforderungen in skalierbare und pragmatische technische Lösungen Dein Profil Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Backend- und Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET , idealerweise bereits mit technischer Verantwortung Fundierte Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur, Architekturdesign und der Entwicklung verteilter Systeme Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung von Entwicklern , beispielsweise als Technical Lead, Lead Developer oder erfahrener Senior Developer mit Architekturverantwortung Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich relationaler Datenbanken und API-Schnittstellen Erfahrung mit Microservices, Containerisierung und modernen Cloud-nativen Entwicklungsumgebungen Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Clean Code, Softwarequalität, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Security Du kannst technische Entscheidungen fundiert treffen, verständlich kommunizieren und andere Entwickler fachlich überzeugen Du arbeitest gerne hands-on und möchtest trotz technischer Verantwortung weiterhin selbst entwickeln Interesse daran, KI sinnvoll in Entwicklungsprozesse zu integrieren Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Das bietet unser Kunde 100 % Remote Work innerhalb Deutschlands (mit Standorten in Berlin und Leipzig) 30 Tage Urlaub plus zusätzliche flexible Zusatzoptionen Technische Führungsverantwortung ohne Personalführung - dein Fokus liegt auf Technologie, Architektur und Softwarequalität Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, technologische Entscheidungen maßgeblich mitzugestalten Eine hands-on Lead-Rolle , in der du weiterhin aktiv entwickelst Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Coachings und Wissensformate Ein strukturiertes Onboarding und regelmäßige 1:1 für deine Bedürfnisse Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Du liebst C#/.NET , denkst gerne in Architekturen und möchtest technisch den Ton angeben, ohne direkt einen ganzen Personalapparat führen zu müssen? Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, Standards setzen und trotzdem weiterhin selbst Code schreiben, statt deinen Kalender ausschließlich mit Meetings zu füllen? Dann sollten wir sprechen! Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und erzählen dir im ersten Austausch gerne mehr über die Rolle, das Team und unseren Kunden.

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Developer
review_candidates.description: About The Company SmartSourcing Ltd is a leading provider of innovative supply chain solutions, committed to delivering excellence in logistics and technology services. With a focus on integrating cutting-edge technology with operational expertise, we serve a diverse range of industries including food and beverage, retail, and manufacturing. Our company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and dynamic work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are at the core of our business philosophy. We are dedicated to supporting our clients' growth by providing tailored logistics solutions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure timely delivery across the supply chain network. About The Role We are seeking a skilled and motivated Web Developer to join our dynamic IT team at SmartSourcing Ltd. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing new applications and maintaining existing web-based systems that support our supply chain operations. Working closely with the WMS Development Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the seamless functionality, security, and performance of our web applications. Your contributions will directly impact the efficiency of our logistics processes and enhance the user experience for our internal teams and clients. This is an excellent opportunity for a developer seeking to apply their technical expertise in a fast-paced, innovative environment with a focus on logistics and supply chain management. Qualifications Proven experience in web and application development, ideally within a 3PL or logistics environment. Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET Framework, including experience with .NET 8 / .NET 10. Hands-on experience with ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET Core, and REST/Web APIs. Solid understanding of SQL Server, with strong T-SQL skills, including stored procedures, views, functions, and complex queries. Experience with Entity Framework / EF6 and version control systems such as Git. Proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Knowledge of Windows Services and understanding of various deployment environments (DEV/TEST/PRE-PROD/PROD). Familiarity with application security, authentication, and role-based access control. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate situations and develop effective solutions. Strong interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills. Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Responsibilities Design, develop, and support full lifecycle application development, ensuring timely resolution of issues and implementation of fixes or workarounds. Maintain source control of codebases using agreed-upon tools, ensuring code is always checked in and up-to-date. Collaborate with other developers to develop new applications or enhance existing systems, fostering a team-oriented approach. Manage the Solar Winds Service Desk system by identifying and categorizing issues, re-allocating tasks as necessary, and ensuring prompt resolution. Handle change requests related to CIA, including identifying issues, providing fixes, and coordinating with team members for resolution. Research and evaluate new software tools, techniques, or methodologies to improve current applications and develop future solutions. Monitor application performance and reliability, ensuring secure, efficient, and user-friendly systems for end-users. Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to uphold quality standards and facilitate ongoing maintenance. Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to web development and logistics solutions. Benefits SmartSourcing Ltd offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth. These include competitive salary packages, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. We promote a positive work environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and recognition. Additionally, employees have access to health insurance plans, paid leave, and other perks aimed at maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Our commitment is to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered to contribute to our collective success. Equal Opportunity SmartSourcing Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. SPONSORSHIP IS NOT AVAILABLE NOW OR IN THE FUTURE DBS CHECK REQUIRED
